description: NixOS system management tool with CLI commands, modular config system, prebuild hardware checks, declarative user/package/device management, and homelab/VM/SSH functionality

highLevelStructure.nixos/core: System-level NixOS modules (base OS + management tools)
highLevelStructure.nixos/modules: Higher-level application modules (infrastructure, security, specialized, system)
highLevelStructure.nixos/custom: User's personal NixOS modules (preserved across updates, never overwritten)
highLevelStructure.nixos/flake.nix: Flake entry point — imports config-loader → discovers systemConfig/
highLevelStructure.shell: Dev shell entry point and runtime scripts
highLevelStructure.docs: LEGACY docs — NOT maintained, historical reference only
highLevelStructure.chronicle: EMPTY — placeholder for chronicle documentation system

steps.description: Checks systemConfig/ structure, detects config version, validates all config.nix files
v0→v1: extract fields, write config files, delete system-config.nix
